Catalogue information

About the data

These records come from the public Paint Commons catalogue. The colour wall uses Stipplewise’s shared colour-family ordering, with each run arranged from dark to light. Similar swatches across brands can share a tile; its count opens the separate paint records. These groups indicate visual similarity, not a declared paint equivalence. Open one to see its source, barcode evidence, and any declared equivalents. Swatches are sampled or inferred from charts and photographs; they are not measured paint matches.

The catalogue checks for new published records when you open this page, with a bundled snapshot as a fallback. The revision above identifies the records you’re viewing.

Catalogue data follows the CC0 dedication, with source-specific exceptions. Imported records retain their source credits, including Rick Fleuren / Miniature Painter Pro. See the full source and licence notices. Paint and brand names belong to their respective owners.

To suggest a correction, open a paint and choose “Suggest a correction”. You don’t need an account. Each suggestion is posted publicly as an issue on the catalogue’s GitHub repository, where a maintainer reviews it. Paint Commons keeps no name, email, or IP address with a suggestion. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that the sender isn’t an automated program.
